firstPlayerRule: Players draw cards; the highest card chooses a seat and plays first in the first deal. The player to that player’s right deals the first hand.
officialTieBreak: Players drawing equal cards or jokers draw again.
clarifications: For the draw, suits rank spades (high), hearts, diamonds, clubs.
After the first hand, the turn to play always starts with the player to the dealer’s left.
